title: Smoked Mediterranean Lentil Bowl
description: A flavorful and hearty vegan bowl filled with the rich flavors of the Mediterranean, featuring smoked lentils and a variety of spices.
instructions: 1. Rinse the lentils and pick out any debris; place them in a medium saucepan with 2 cups of water.
2. Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook until the lentils are tender, about 20-25 minutes.
3. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
4. Add the chopped red onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
5. Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
6. Stir in the smoked paprika and Mediterranean seasoning; cook for 1-2 minutes.
7. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook until they start to release their juices, about 3-4 minutes.
8. Fluff the cooked lentils with a fork and stir them into the skillet with the onion and tomato mixture.
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped parsley.
10. Serve the smoked lentil mixture over a bed of rice or enjoy as a bowl on its own.
